resources.string: Need Help? / File Doesn\'t Exist? / Java Error?
File Doesn\'t exist! Check file path?
1. In the browse section. Select File Manager in The Navigation Drawer > then Navigate to the file > Select > Hit okay.
2. Do not select file from the Download, Recent or any other option.
3. Or go to file Manager > select the file > send/share the file > select PCM Player and Converter to Play.
Error while Selecting the File? (Java Illegal Argument)
1. Just try to Browse again and do it from File Manager in Nav Draw of Browse Section only.
2. Go to file Manager > select the file > send/share the file > select PCM Player and Converter to Play.
2. We would update the app and roll out in next few days.
3. update your app from play store and Enjoy :)
If you want some feature to be implemented or report a bug. Please mail us at rajatnagpureiiest@gmail.com.
